summary: ERC20-style token plus an ETH vault with pro-rata shares, withdraw fees and reward distribution.

defects.title: Withdraw pays out before updating share accounting
defects.description: withdraw() sends the net ETH payout (and pending rewards) via external calls before rewards are zeroed, rewardsOwed is decremented, and shares are burned, so a contract receiver can re-enter and be paid the same rewards and principal again.
defects.trigger: A contract receiver calls withdraw(); its receive() re-enters withdraw() while the payout call is in flight.
defects.observed: Receiver is paid ~28.75 ETH against a 20 ETH entitlement (10 ETH deposit + 10 ETH rewards).

defects.title: transferFrom decrements allowance without checking it
defects.description: The allowance decrement runs inside an unchecked block with no allowance >= amount guard, so a spender with zero allowance can move a victim's tokens and the allowance wraps to ~2^256.
defects.trigger: spender calls transferFrom(victim, spender, 60e18) with no approval.
defects.observed: 60 tokens move from the victim and the recorded allowance wraps to 2^256-60.

defects.title: sharePrice divides by totalShares with no zero guard
defects.description: sharePrice() computes totalAssets() * 1e18 / totalShares; on an empty vault totalShares is 0 and the call reverts with Panic 0x12.
defects.observed: Staticcall reverts with panic code 0x12 (division by zero).

defects.title: First-depositor share inflation zeros later deposits
defects.description: The first depositor can mint 1 share for 1 wei and then donate ETH via receive(); a subsequent 1 ETH deposit mints shares that round to 0 and is still accepted, letting the first depositor redeem the victim's ETH.
defects.trigger: deposit() 1 wei, send 10 ETH to the vault directly, then a victim deposits 1 ETH.
defects.observed: Victim is minted 0 shares; the 1-wei first depositor withdraws ~11 ETH.

defects.title: setFeeRecipient has no owner check
defects.description: Anyone can call setFeeRecipient and redirect all future withdraw fees to an arbitrary address.

defects.title: Admin setter authorizes on tx.origin
defects.description: setWithdrawFeeBps checks tx.origin == owner, so any contract the owner transacts with can call back in and set the fee up to MAX_FEE_BPS.
defects.trigger: Owner calls a third-party contract that invokes vault.setWithdrawFeeBps(1000) in the same transaction.
defects.observed: withdrawFeeBps becomes 1000 (10%) through the proxied call.

defects.title: Fee transfer return value is ignored
defects.description: _payFee makes a low-level call to feeRecipient and discards the return value; when the recipient reverts on receive, the withdraw succeeds, the user is charged the fee, and the fee simply stays in the vault.
defects.trigger: feeRecipient is a contract that reverts on receive; a holder withdraws with a 10% fee.
defects.observed: User receives 9 ETH (1 ETH fee deducted) while the fee recipient holds 0 ETH.

defects.title: Per-account shares truncated into a uint128 slot
defects.description: deposit() packs shares into a uint128 via an unchecked downcast; a deposit of 2^128 + x wei mints 2^128 + x shares but records only x for the account.
defects.trigger: Deposit 2^128 + 1000 wei into an empty vault.
defects.observed: sharesOf(depositor) returns 1000 while the deposit was 2^128 + 1000 wei.

defects.title: Reward distribution loops an unbounded holder list
defects.description: deposit() pushes to holders on every call including duplicates, and distributeRewards iterates all entries; with ~1000 entries a call capped at 3,000,000 gas runs out of gas.
defects.trigger: 200 depositors each deposit 1 wei 5 times, then owner calls distributeRewards with a 3M gas cap.
defects.observed: holders.length is 1000 and the distribution call fails (out of gas).

defects.title: Reward per share computed by dividing before scaling
defects.description: distributeRewards computes perShare = msg.value / totalShares and multiplies afterwards, so any reward smaller than totalShares accrues 0 to every holder and the ETH stays stranded in the vault.
defects.trigger: Two holders with 10 ETH deposits; owner distributes 1e15 wei.
defects.observed: reward credited is 0 and the ETH is not credited to anyone; the full 1e15 wei remains unallocated in the vault.
